pensamiento:
I'm checking each user story criterion in turn: the role and action are there, it has a single objective, and it has no extra notes. The benefit "so that I don't get bored" reads more as a value than a functional reason, but I'm still counting it as passing.

I'm going through the rest of the quality checks: the story is vague about "quickly" with no measure, which is a defect, and I'm finding no conflicts or duplicates against similar stories. The format matches the backlog's English style. On the investment criteria, it's independent and the benefit reads as valuable, but the scope of "the application" is undefined, so it can't be estimated yet and I'm leaning toward a major defect and a reference estimate.

I'm working through the remaining checks and marking the estimation criterion as not evaluable, since the scope is too vague to size it; I'll record a 1 and note that in a recommendation instead of flagging a defect. The acceptance criteria check is a blocker because none are given. I'm not seeing an external dependency for the response-time requirement, so I'll mark that as not applicable and consider whether the undefined time limit belongs under the business-rules check or the "quickly" defect.

I'm settling DOR-002: the only implicit limit is the vague "quickly", which is already covered by the performance requirement under DOR-003, so I'll mark DOR-002 as not applicable to avoid counting the same gap twice. DOR-003 does apply, since responsiveness is the core non-functional need here and no measurable target is stated, so I'm marking it as not met.

I'm checking the defects I've found so far: the vague "quickly" in the user story, the missing scope that makes it impossible to estimate, the absence of acceptance criteria, and the lack of a measurable responsiveness target. Those four lead me to reject the story, and I'm noting that its estimate should be 1. I see no duplicates, and I'm now thinking about what a refined version of the story would look like in Spanish, without inventing any numbers or scope.

I'm weighing whether the story's "so that I don't get bored" benefit counts as a real functional reason, and I'm deciding how to record the one-point estimate and why, since the scope can't be sized. I'm also settling the acceptance criteria field for a rejected story, and I'm drafting the recommendations so each defect points the analyst toward a measurable threshold, a defined scope, and concrete acceptance criteria.

I'm settling the type of the story as functional, since it describes a behavior the application must have.

recomendaciones.texto: Reemplazar 'respond quickly' (término vago) por una medida concreta: por ejemplo, tiempo máximo de respuesta en segundos, para qué tipo de acción y en qué condiciones de red. El analista debe definir el umbral; no se debe asumir.
Precisar el alcance: qué acciones del usuario (pantallas, operaciones o flujos concretos) deben responder rápido. Sin ese alcance el equipo no puede estimar.

Agregar criterios de aceptación como reglas u lista de verificación con resultados observables, por ejemplo: 'Al ejecutar [ACCIÓN], la respuesta se muestra en menos de [TIEMPO]'. La HU no tiene criterios hoy.
Declarar el requisito no funcional de rendimiento de forma medible (tiempo de respuesta, percentil y condiciones de medición), ya que la rapidez de respuesta es el objetivo central de la HU.
